title: OSF Identity preset dependency metadata
description: Optional <localFormId>.json beside a convention <localFormId>.npc preset. A malformed sidecar disables only its matching preset. Omit requires when the preset has no additional dependencies.

$schema.description: Optional editor hint pointing to preset-metadata.schema.json. OSF Identity does not load this URI at runtime.

schemaVersion.description: OSF Identity preset metadata format version.

requires.description: Dependencies for this preset only. They are additive with pack-wide requirements and the implicit owning plugin.

plugin.description: An ESM, ESP, or ESL filename without directory separators or a drive prefix.

relativePath.description: A Data-relative path without a drive prefix, leading separator, or parent traversal component.

plugins.description: Plugin filenames that must be loaded. Matching and duplicate detection are case-insensitive at runtime.

assets.description: Loose files that must exist beneath the Starfield Data directory. Matching and duplicate detection are case-insensitive at runtime.
